Nadia (Finance): Heads-up: InvoicePilot sent the renewal + last month's invoice that includes a mysterious 'integration fee'. Renewal list is +20%. Can procurement check if that fee was in our contract and run an alternative vendor compare?

Caleb (Procurement): On it. Two alternatives to evaluate: ScaleMeter and FlowCharge. Need our last 10 months usage by sku (events, API calls, bytes). If someone can export, I9ll share sanitized data under NDA.

Rui (Platform): InvoicePilot currently pushes daily Parquet exports to our S3 bucket and we run delta reconciles. FlowCharge claims they support incremental webhooks which could remove the nightly batch. That might reduce our reconciliation Lambda spend ~12%. Need sample webhook payload.

Asha (DevOps): Quick technical risk: switching vendors may require replaying 6 months of events into the new schema. I can script an ETL but need to know export format differences. Also confirm rate limits for backfill.

Ben (Security): Before sharing any data request SOC2 Type II cert, DPA, subprocessors list, and encryption details. If FlowCharge or ScaleMeter want usage data, they must sign our standard NDA + DPA.

Caleb (Procurement): I'll send the RFP to all three: line items to include base, per-event, storage/egress, API rate limits, backfill pricing, onboarding credit, SLA credits, and termination terms. Also ask for a pilot discount.

vendor-bot: InvoicePilot uploaded invoice_1779981300.pdf and renewal_offer_1779981320.pdf. Invoice notes: integration_fee=12500; line ref IP-INTG-2025.

Nadia (Finance): Evan, can you pull the last 10 months usage by sku? Need monthly totals to model per-event vs flat fee. If we present committed usage we have better leverage.

Evan (Billing): Posting sanitized CSV to #finance-data in 45m. Sample row:

```
month,sku,events,api_calls,bytes
2024-11,billable_events,145000,21000,312000000
```

Evan (Billing): Full export ETA 45 minutes.

Caleb (Procurement): Target negotiation ask for InvoicePilot: 15% off list OR 9 months at current rate + 3 months free on a 12mo commit. Also ask for migration credit if we switch.

Rui (Platform): If ScaleMeter offers delta webhooks and the payload matches our current fields (event_id, timestamp, sku, qty), we can do a proof-of-concept in 2 weeks. Otherwise migration will be longer.

Asha (DevOps): Add a question in the RFP: can vendors replay historical exports in compressed Parquet and accept multi-threaded ingest? If not, include estimated backfill time and costs.

Ben (Security): Also ask about key management: do they support bringing-your-own-key (BYOK) and TLS mutual auth for webhooks?

Caleb (Procurement): I'll send the RFP within 48h once Evan uploads the usage. Will attach sanitized usage under NDA.

Nadia (Finance): Great. Next steps: Evan upload, Caleb send RFP, Ben compile security checklist, Asha map migration tasks. Reconvene in 5 days to review responses. /remind me 5 days
